premise.claim: Dependabot: keep the pinned ossf/scorecard-action dependency current (2.4.4 -> 2.5.0). No runtime bug is claimed; the risk to verify is that the bump itself is malformed (wrong pin, missing image, incompatible inputs).
premise.evidence: results/check-action-bump-head-838b73be.txt — pin matches tag v2.5.0, all workflow inputs still honored, image manifest 200, publish endpoint 200.

unit.note: C1 (pin==tag) and C2 (inputs honored) are the deterministic checks; they need network to github.com but no cluster.

integration.cmd: same script, checks C3 (ghcr.io manifest) and C4 (api.scorecard.dev) — read-only GETs against the real upstream services
integration.note: L3 live layer (running the actual GitHub Actions workflow) is intentionally skipped per debate setup; the workflow only triggers on schedule/push to master, so it cannot run pre-merge anyway.

findings.claim: The SHA pinned in the workflow is exactly the peeled commit of upstream tag v2.5.0.
All inputs the workflow passes (results_file, results_format=sarif, publish_results) are still declared/honored by the action at the new pin.
The container image referenced by the new action.yaml (ghcr.io/ossf/scorecard-action:v2.5.0) exists.
The publish endpoint used by publish_results:true (https://api.scorecard.dev) is alive.
exclude_checks/exclude_paths are dead inputs in both v2.4.4 and v2.5.0 (no EXCLUDE handling in the action source). Informational check; prints the state, never fails the harness.
